title: Kuration SDK: Addressing the Virtual2Real Gap via Data Curation
title_zh: Kuration SDK: 通过数据整理解决虚拟到现实的差距问题

paragraphs.en: Robot Learning with World Models: Capabilities, Frontiers, and Challenges
paragraphs.zh: 基于世界模型的机器人学习：能力、前沿与挑战

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks for measuring the quality of action-conditioned world models are still evolving and shifting away from visual similarity-based metrics to action-semantic and physically-grounded metrics. However, for domain and task-agnostic action-conditioned world model training, existing benchmarks provide a limited signal. By training and evaluating diffusion world models on CounterStrike gameplay data, we confirm that qualitative playability does not correspond with metrics such as FVD, LPIPS, and JEDi. We term this the Virtual2Real gap. We posit that, in lieu of reliable benchmarks, curating raw gameplay data and measuring a variety of diagnostic properties provides a more robust signal to bridge the gap, before the training even begins. We present several curation strategies and a general-purpose kit for physical AI data curation called Kuration SDK , which is being open-sourced with this paper 1 1 1 https://drive.google.com/file/d/1tbq9zW12YJTt9bw4UL2n3r576je1G0OU . The SDK was instrumental in uncovering the root cause of the virtual2real gap in a specific case: why two world models trained on identical gameplay map, action and state distribution, behaved very differently when played in spite of having very similar LPIPS and FVD scores. Thus, Kuration SDK has the potential to uncover the root causes of Virtual2Real gap in specific datasets and accelerate development of sample-efficient training datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 用于衡量动作条件世界模型质量的基准仍在不断演变，正从基于视觉相似性的指标转向基于动作语义和物理基础的指标。 然而，对于跨领域和跨任务的通用动作条件世界模型训练，现有基准提供的信号十分有限。 通过在《反恐精英》游戏数据上训练和评估扩散世界模型，我们证实了定性的可玩性与 FVD、LPIPS 和 JEDi 等指标并不对应。 我们将此现象称为“虚拟到现实”鸿沟。 我们认为，在缺乏可靠基准的情况下，整理原始游戏数据并测量多种诊断属性，能够在训练开始前就提供更稳健的信号以弥合这一鸿沟。 我们提出了几种数据整理策略，以及一个用于物理 AI 数据整理的通用工具包——Kuration SDK，该工具包随本文一同开源 1 1 1 https://drive.google.com/file/d/1tbq9zW12YJTt9bw4UL2n3r576je1G0OU 。 该 SDK 在特定案例中发挥了关键作用，揭示了“虚拟到现实”鸿沟的根本原因：为何两个基于完全相同游戏地图、动作和状态分布训练的世界模型，尽管 LPIPS 和 FVD 分数非常接近，在实际运行中的表现却截然不同。 因此，Kuration SDK 有潜力揭示特定数据集中“虚拟到现实”鸿沟的根本原因，并加速开发样本效率高的训练数据集。

paragraphs.en: In the case of LLMs, training data curation and data quality ablation experiments were critical in accelerating task performance of LLMs, e.g., large-scale web-text curation pipelines such as FineWeb ( Penedo et al., 2024 ) that filter and deduplicate raw crawl data before it ever reaches a training run. Well-established and meaningful benchmark metrics for evaluating foundational language capability enabled that progress, and generative modeling more broadly has shown predictable improvements with more data and compute ( Henighan et al., 2020 ) . However, meaningful metrics for action-conditioned world models are still evolving. State-of-the-art benchmarks are either task-specific and require an agent to be trained and evaluated on task performance or do not provide a meaningful signal on model capability. Then, what is the role of data curation for training foundational and task-agnostic action-conditioned world models? This is the central question this paper investigates.
paragraphs.zh: 对于大型语言模型（LLM）而言，训练数据的筛选与数据质量的消融实验在加速其任务表现方面至关重要。例如，FineWeb（Penedo 等人，2024）这类大规模网络文本筛选流程，会在原始爬取数据进入训练阶段之前对其进行过滤和去重处理。 成熟且富有意义的基准指标为评估基础语言能力提供了依据，从而推动了相关进展；更广泛地看，生成式建模领域也表明，随着数据和计算资源的增加，模型性能会呈现出可预测的提升（Henighan 等人，2020）。 然而，针对动作条件世界模型的有意义指标仍在不断演进中。 当前最先进的基准测试要么局限于特定任务，要求智能体在任务表现上进行训练与评估；要么无法提供反映模型能力的有效信号。 那么，在训练基础且与任务无关的动作条件世界模型时，数据筛选究竟扮演了怎样的角色？ 这正是本文所探讨的核心问题。

paragraphs.en: Playing a pretrained DIAMOND ( Alonso et al., 2024 ) model, a diffusion world model trained on CS:GO gameplay, makes the problem concrete. Rollouts are visually coherent for roughly the first thirty frames; beyond that horizon, the model loses track of the player’s position and teleports to a visually similar but geographically distinct part of the map, and it permits actions the game physics never allow, such as walking through parked cars or repeated double-jumps against a wall. We use playability throughout to mean exactly these observable failures, map teleportation, geometry clipping, physics-violating actions, and control responsiveness and recovery, judged by the authors via interactive rollout inspection rather than a formal protocol or external, blinded raters (Section 7.2 ). Such failures are attributed to the training data rather than the architecture: raw competitive gameplay rarely contains sustained collisions, since good players avoid walking into walls, and it contains double-jump exploits often enough for the model to treat them as normal transitions.
paragraphs.zh: 通过运行一个预训练的 DIAMOND（Alonso 等人，2024）模型——该模型是一个基于《CS:GO》游戏过程训练的扩散世界模型——可以使这个问题具体化。 在大约最初的三十帧中，生成的画面是连贯的；但超过这一时间范围后，模型便无法追踪玩家的位置，而是会瞬移到地图上视觉上相似但地理位置不同的区域，并且允许执行游戏物理机制从未允许过的操作，例如穿过停放的汽车或反复对墙进行二段跳。 我们在全文中使用的“可玩性”一词，特指这些可观察到的失败现象：地图瞬移、几何体穿模、违反物理规律的操作，以及控制响应性和恢复能力；作者通过交互式生成过程检查来评估这些方面，而非依赖正式协议或外部盲测评分者（第 7.2 节）。 这类失败归因于训练数据而非模型架构：原始竞技游戏录像中很少出现持续碰撞，因为高水平玩家会避免撞墙；而其中包含足够多的二段跳漏洞，以至于模型会将这些操作视为正常的状态转换。

paragraphs.en: By training action-conditioned world models on two gameplay datasets having identical state and action distributions, identical game world map, identical volumes, frame rates, resolution, and near identical game engines (CounterStrike:GO and CounterStrike2), we show that state-of-the-art benchmarks do not correspond to qualitative "playability" of the models. Similar to the Sim2Real gap, we term this the Virtual2Real gap. Given the lack of meaningful benchmarks to investigate this gap, we built a set of data diagnostics and curation tools we call Kuration SDK . The SDK was instrumental in uncovering the root cause of the gap: the magnitude of visual shift per action differed by 1.4 1.4 – 2.1 × 2.1\times across the two datasets. Section 2 situates this against prior world-model and benchmark work; Sections 3 – 5 present the controlled experiment and root-cause diagnosis; Section 7 evaluates curation strategies against FVD, LPIPS, and JEDi; Section 8 discusses the implications for benchmarking gameplay world models. Our contributions:

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate the Virtual2Real gap directly: two diffusion world models trained on format- and distribution-matched CS:GO and CS2 corpora diverge sharply in qualitative playability despite comparable or better scores on FVD, LPIPS, and JEDi.
paragraphs.zh: 我们直接展示了 Virtual2Real 差距：两个在格式和分布匹配的 CS:GO 与 CS2 语料库上训练的扩散世界模型，尽管在 FVD、LPIPS 和 JEDi 上的得分相当甚至更优，但在定性可玩性方面却存在显著差异。

paragraphs.en: We survey emerging action-semantic and physically-grounded benchmarks and show none offers a general-purpose, domain-agnostic quality signal for gameplay world models, motivating data-level diagnostics as an alternative.
paragraphs.zh: 我们调研了新兴的动作-语义和物理基础基准测试，并指出目前没有任何一种能为游戏世界模型提供通用且与领域无关的质量信号，因此数据层面的诊断方法成为一个有吸引力的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: Using the Kuration SDK, we test a set of curation hypotheses and identify action-state consistency, whether a given input reliably produces the same characteristic screen motion, and specifically its magnitude, as the leading candidate explanation: the two corpora differ by roughly 2 × 2\times on this axis, a difference neither FVD nor LPIPS detects.
paragraphs.zh: 借助 Kuration SDK，我们测试了一系列策展假设，并识别了动作与状态之间的一致性：即给定的输入是否稳定地产生相同的特征屏幕运动，尤其是其幅度。这被视为首要的候选解释：在这条轴向上，两个语料库的差异约为 2 × 2\times，而这种差异既未被 FVD 也未被 LPIPS 检测到。

paragraphs.en: We release the Kuration SDK, an open-source toolkit for gameplay data curation, together with the curation strategies and full evaluation results from this paper, so the community can reproduce, extend, or apply these diagnostics to new corpora.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发布了 Kuration SDK——一套用于游戏数据策展的开源工具包，并同步公开了本文中的策展策略及完整的评估结果，以便社区能够复现、扩展或将这些诊断方法应用于新的语料库。

paragraphs.en: World models predicting future observations conditioned on actions have been proposed as planning and policy-learning substrates without further real-world interaction ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ) . Genie ( Bruce et al., 2024 ) pursues data scale, pretraining on internet-scale video with no action labels. GameNGen ( Valevski et al., 2025 ) and DIAMOND ( Alonso et al., 2024 ) , real-time diffusion game world models, are the closest comparisons; we use DIAMOND as our baseline. Reported failure modes (map teleportation, geometry clipping) are attributed to the training corpus, but, to our knowledge, no prior work tests this against a second, independently captured corpus matched on format and scale, the gap Section 4 closes.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究提出，基于动作条件预测未来观测结果的世界模型，可作为规划和策略学习的底层基础，而无需进一步的真实世界交互（Ha 和 Schmidhuber，2018；Hafner 等，2023）。 Genie（Bruce 等，2024）追求数据规模，在没有任何动作标签的互联网级视频上进行预训练。 GameNGen（Valevski 等，2025）和 DIAMOND（Alonso 等，2024）是实时扩散游戏世界模型，也是最接近的对比对象；我们将 DIAMOND 用作基线模型。 已报告的故障模式（地图瞬移、几何裁剪）归因于训练语料库，但据我们所知，尚无先前的工作对此进行验证：即使用在格式和规模上相匹配的第二个独立采集的语料库进行测试，而第 4 节正是填补了这一空白。

paragraphs.en: FVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) compute a Fréchet distance over I3D features and a per-frame perceptual distance; neither targets single-interaction physical violations. JEDi ( Luo et al., 2024 ) replaces I3D with V-JEPA ( Bardes et al., 2024 ) features, predicting future latent states rather than classifying actions, and so is, in principle, more sensitive to how a scene evolves (Sections 4 , 7 ). Newer benchmarks targeting action-semantics or physical grounding directly are not yet general-purpose: ACT-Bench ( Turing Motors et al., 2025 ) needs a per-game trajectory or pose estimator, built for continuous 3D ego-motion rather than discrete or hybrid action spaces; ARR ( Hu et al., 2026 ) depends on an auxiliary probe trained and validated per game; Atari 100K ( Kaiser et al., 2019 ) and similar task-specific benchmarks do not generalize; and long-horizon drift metrics ( Kwon et al., 2025 ) , an action sequence followed by its inverse checked for return to the start, are self-referential, a round trip can close on an arbitrarily wrong path since no step is individually verified.
paragraphs.zh: FVD（Unterthiner 等人，2018）和 LPIPS（Zhang 等人，2018）在 I3D 特征上计算 Fréchet 距离以及每帧的感知距离；但两者均未针对单次交互中的物理违规行为。 JEDi（Luo 等人，2024）用 V-JEPA（Bardes 等人，2024）特征取代了 I3D，通过预测未来的潜在状态而非对动作进行分类，因此原则上对场景演变过程更为敏感（第 4、7 节）。 更近期的、直接针对动作语义或物理基础问题的基准测试尚未具备通用性：ACT-Bench（Turing Motors 等人，2025）需要每局游戏独立的轨迹或姿态估计器，该估计器是为连续三维自运动设计的，而非离散或混合动作空间；ARR（Hu 等人，2026）依赖一个按每款游戏训练和验证的辅助探测器；Atari 100K（Kaiser 等人，2019）及类似的任务特定基准测试不具备泛化能力；而长时程漂移指标（Kwon 等人，2025）——即执行一个动作序列后，再执行其逆序以检查是否返回起点——具有自指性，因为整个往返过程可能沿着任意错误的路径完成，而无需单独验证每一步。

paragraphs.en: Subset selection from a large corpus is well studied for language and vision-language data (semantic deduplication ( Abbas et al., 2023 ) , coverage-driven filtering ( Li et al., 2024 ) ) over fixed text or image embeddings, which do not expose the features that matter here, physical interaction, action-state consistency, spatial trajectory, thus motivating gameplay-specific operators.
paragraphs.zh: 从大型语料库中进行子集选择这一问题，在语言和视觉-语言数据领域已有广泛研究（语义去重（Abbas 等人，2023），以覆盖率为驱动的过滤（Li 等人，2024）），这些方法通常基于固定的文本或图像嵌入，但并未揭示此处真正重要的特征——物理交互、动作与状态的一致性以及空间轨迹，因此需要针对游戏玩法设计特定的算子。

paragraphs.en: To attribute any downstream effect to data rather than to our own training or evaluation code, we first reproduced DIAMOND on its published CS:GO dataset.

paragraphs.en: DIAMOND is a two-stage architecture: a denoiser conditioned on the previous four frames and actions, operating at 30 × 56 30\times 56 , and an independently trained upsampler mapping denoiser output to 150 × 280 150\times 280 . Actions are discrete, spanning 20 categories of mouse and keyboard input. We matched the published configuration (learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 2 10^{-2} , 600 epochs of 400 steps), and effective batch size.

paragraphs.en: Our 600-epoch run reaches FVD 4.4 % 4.4\% below DIAMOND’s reported value at epoch 300 and LPIPS 4.2 % 4.2\% above it at epoch 420, both within evaluation stochasticity. Running the released DIAMOND weights through our own pipeline reproduces the paper’s numbers within 1 % 1\% , confirming our evaluation code (Table 1 ; per-30-epoch curve in Figure 3 , Appendix A ). Interactive rollouts from the reproduced model match DIAMOND’s published qualitative standard at short horizons; the long-horizon spatial teleportation and geometry-clipping failure modes described in Section 1 are present but, being multi-frame phenomena, are not visible in any single frame, part of why frame-level and short-clip metrics struggle to detect them.

paragraphs.en: An action-conditioned world model learns only the mapping between an input and the screen motion that follows it; if that mapping is inconsistent in the data, the model cannot distinguish a genuine rule from an anomaly. Game engines routinely break this contract for reasons unrelated to world dynamics, coyote time, input buffering, lag compensation, deliberate choices that make a game feel responsive to a human player. pixel_shift measures the optical-flow displacement following every uninterrupted key press, projected onto the axis that control should move the camera on; action_state_consistency aggregates this into a per-control, per-press-length response curve.
paragraphs.zh: 一种以行动为条件的世界模型仅学习输入与其随后屏幕运动之间的映射关系；如果数据中这种映射不一致，该模型便无法区分真正的规则与异常。 游戏引擎通常会出于与世界动态无关的原因破坏这一约定，例如“科约特时间”、输入缓冲、延迟补偿，以及为了让游戏对人类玩家更具响应性而做出的刻意设计。pixel_shift 测量每次连续按键后产生的光流位移，并将其投影到控制本应移动摄像头的轴上；action_state_consistency 则将这些数据汇总为每条控制通道和每次按键时长对应的响应曲线。

paragraphs.en: This is a measurable difference neither FVD nor LPIPS can detect. It also tracks which model plays better: CS:GO DIAMOND, despite its own map-teleportation and clipping failures, is more responsive and controllable than baseline_v1 , despite baseline_v1 matching or beating it on LPIPS and FVD. Of the three axes, magnitude is the most plausible driver: a larger, more visually salient pixel shift per action gives a denoising, action-conditioned model a stronger training signal to key its predictions on, relative to other sources of frame-to-frame variation; a weaker signal, as in CS2, is easier to under-weight, even though CS2 is arguably the more physically well-behaved corpus on momentum and symmetry. We have not yet run a controlled ablation isolating magnitude from momentum and symmetry, so we report magnitude as the leading hypothesis, not a proven one. CS:GO and CS2 also run on different engine generations (Source vs. Source 2), so part of this measured difference could in principle reflect an engine-level property rather than a purely curatable data-selection one; matching map, resolution, frame rate, and action encoding (Section 4 ) narrows this confound but does not eliminate it (Section 7.2 ). What is established without qualification: two corpora indistinguishable by format specification differ measurably in exactly the property an action-conditioned model depends on, and that difference tracks playability where FVD and LPIPS do not.

paragraphs.en: kuration.gameplay ships the operators used in this paper. pixel_shift and action_state_consistency implement Section 5 (pipeline example in Appendix B ). collision finds and classifies wall-hits from an expected unobstructed-movement curve so they can be oversampled relative to their naturally low base rate, targeting the wall-clipping failure mode of Section 1 . slam_reconstruct , slam_quality , and slam_motion_diversity recover a camera’s 3D trajectory from video with no positional metadata and score it for gaps, impossible motion, and turning and path-length diversity, turning spatial coverage into a curatable axis for footage that started with none. Three general-purpose selection recipes, equal coverage across quantile bins of any feature, oversampling a rare event to a target rate, and cluster-then-sample diversity selection, compose with any of the above without new code. All strategies used below, and the full evaluation results, are released alongside the SDK.

paragraphs.en: The action-state consistency finding motivates curating for specific behavioral properties rather than simply collecting more data, but it was one of four hypotheses we tested, not a foregone conclusion. Using the SDK, we curated the CS2 corpus along four strategies and compared each against baseline_v1 as the uncurated control, judging every checkpoint by the same qualitative rollout inspection used in Section 4 . Coverage-based sampling selects segments to uniformly cover quantile bins over aim velocity, input entropy, and movement speed, trained from scratch for 120 of a planned 600 epochs on 7,530 episodes. Rare-trajectory up-weighting selects segments where movement speed falls in the tail (mean 43.9 43.9 vs. corpus mean 27.2 27.2 ), fine-tuned 60 epochs from baseline_v1 ’s epoch-300 checkpoint. Collision-aware selection up-weights collision-flagged segments (impact rate weighted 2 × 2\times movement speed, 4 × 4\times aim velocity), fine-tuned 55 epochs from the same checkpoint. Action-state-consistency selection , the only strategy motivated directly by the Section 5 diagnosis, up-weights segments with the largest per-action pixel-shift magnitude, moving the training distribution toward CS:GO’s more salient action-to-motion contract.
paragraphs.zh: 动作-状态一致性这一发现促使我们针对特定的行为特性进行筛选，而不仅仅是简单地收集更多数据；但这是我们测试的四个假设之一，而非一个早已注定的结论。 我们使用 SDK 按照四种策略对 CS2 语料库进行了筛选，并将每种策略与未筛选的基准对照 baseline_v1 进行比较，同时依据第 4 节中使用的相同定性展开检验来评估每个检查点。 基于覆盖率的采样方法会选择不同片段，以均匀覆盖目标速度、输入熵和移动速度的分位数区间；该方法在计划中的 600 个训练周期中，从 7,530 个游戏回合开始从头训练了 120 个周期。 罕见轨迹加权方法会选择移动速度处于尾部区间的片段（均值为 43.9 43.9，而语料库均值为 27.2 27.2），并在 baseline_v1 第 300 周期的检查点基础上继续微调 60 个周期。 碰撞感知选择方法会对带有碰撞标记的片段进行加权（碰撞影响率按移动速度的 2 × 2\times、目标速度的 4 × 4\times 进行加权），并在同一检查点基础上继续微调 55 个周期。 动作-状态一致性选择方法是唯一直接由第 5 节诊断结果所驱动的策略，它会对每个动作中像素偏移量最大的片段进行加权，从而将训练分布向 CS:GO 中更显著的动作-运动对应关系靠拢。

paragraphs.en: Of the four curation strategies tested, three, coverage-based, rare-trajectory, and collision-aware, produce no qualitative playability improvement over baseline_v1 , despite each moving at least one metric in the direction that would ordinarily be read as progress: coverage-based reaches near-baseline LPIPS and FVD in a fifth of the training budget ( 105 105 of 120 120 epochs), and collision-aware improves JEDi over the comparably fine-tuned rare-trajectory run (Table 2 ), consistent with collision-rich data helping a metric sensitive to interaction dynamics. Only action-state-consistency selection, the strategy directly motivated by the Section 5 root-cause diagnosis rather than a plausible-sounding proxy, produces a noticeable improvement in playability over baseline_v1 ; we do not yet know whether it closes the gap to CS:GO DIAMOND or narrows it only partially, and we have not run the negative control of curating for the same axis in the wrong direction, so we cannot yet rule out that any sufficiently different fine-tune from the epoch-300 checkpoint would have moved playability. Curating along an axis that sounds physically relevant (rare, physically demanding trajectories; collision events) was not sufficient here, and metric movement on that axis was not a reliable sign that it worked either way.
paragraphs.zh: 在测试的四种策展策略中，三种策略——基于覆盖率的策略、罕见轨迹策略和碰撞感知策略——均未在可玩性方面相较于 baseline_v1 带来任何定性提升，尽管每种策略至少有一个指标朝着通常被视为进步的方向移动：基于覆盖率的策略在训练预算的五分之一（120 个训练周期中的 105 个）内达到了接近基准线的 LPIPS 和 FVD 值；而碰撞感知策略则使 JEDi 优于以相同方式微调的罕见轨迹运行结果（表 2），这与富含碰撞的数据有助于提升对交互动态敏感的指标这一观点一致。 只有“动作-状态一致性”选择策略——即直接基于第 5 节中的根本原因诊断而非某种听起来合理的替代指标所提出的策略——在可玩性方面相较于 baseline_v1 带来了明显提升；但我们尚不清楚该策略是否真正缩小了与 CS:GO DIAMOND 的差距，还是仅部分缩小了差距。此外，我们尚未运行“沿同一轴线反向策展”这一负对照实验，因此目前无法排除任何与第 300 个训练周期检查点足够不同的微调操作本身就可能改变可玩性的可能性。 在此实验中，沿一个听起来具有物理相关性的轴线（如罕见且对物理能力要求高的轨迹、碰撞事件）进行策展并不足以产生效果，而且该轴线上指标的变化也并非可靠的信号，无法证明策展策略是否真正奏效。

paragraphs.en: This is not a claim that FVD and LPIPS are useless: LPIPS tracks progress within a single run, and FVD crosses below DIAMOND’s reported value by epoch 180 of the reproduction (Figure 3 ), a coarse but real convergence signal. The claim is narrower: once models are individually competent, neither metric, nor JEDi, reliably flags which curation hypothesis actually fixes the targeted behavior, which is precisely the regime curation research operates in.
paragraphs.zh: 这并不是说 FVD 和 LPIPS 毫无用处：LPIPS 能够追踪单次运行中的进展，而在复现实验的第 180 个周期内，FVD 的值已经低于 DIAMOND 报告的值（图 3），这是一个粗略但真实的收敛信号。 这一主张的范围更窄：一旦模型各自具备能力，无论是哪种指标，还是 JEDi，都无法可靠地指出究竟是哪一种优化假设真正修正了目标行为，而这恰恰是优化研究所处的研究范畴。

paragraphs.en: Several caveats. Collision-aware LPIPS/FVD, coverage-based JEDi, and all three of action-state-consistency’s quantitative metrics were not completed at time of writing (shared GPU availability); blank cells in Table 2 should not be read as parity, and the action-state-consistency result, including its training schedule, is qualitative only so far. The playability judgments throughout this paper rest on rollout inspection rather than a labeled playability benchmark, since none exists for this setting to our knowledge; a labeled benchmark, or even a second independent rater, would let us report agreement rather than a single team’s judgment. Raters were the authors themselves and were not blinded to which strategy produced a given checkpoint, so expectation bias cannot be ruled out, a concern that applies most directly to the action-state-consistency result, the one motivated by our own root-cause diagnosis. Neither a systematic, shared-test-set sweep of the SDK’s full strategy space nor a statistical action-state-consistency comparison with confidence intervals per control and press length has been run; Section 5 reports single-tap summaries, and multi-tap presses show the same pattern but are omitted here for space. CS:GO and CS2 are also not the same engine: beyond the map, resolution, frame rate, and action encoding we matched, they differ in engine generation (Source vs. Source 2) and underlying physics and netcode, so part of the action-state consistency gap of Section 5 could reflect an engine-level property rather than a purely fixable data-selection one; we cannot yet separate the two with a single corpus pair. More broadly, every result in this paper comes from one map, one architecture (DIAMOND), and one game family; the "task-agnostic" motivation in Section 1 is the question this work investigates, not a generality we have yet demonstrated beyond this setting.
paragraphs.zh: 几点注意事项。在撰写本文时，碰撞感知 LPIPS/FVD、基于覆盖率的 JEDi 以及动作状态一致性相关的三项定量指标均未完成（受共享 GPU 可用性的限制）；表 2 中的空白单元格不应被解读为结果一致，且动作状态一致性的结果（包括其训练计划）目前仅为定性分析。本文中的所有可玩性判断均基于展开过程的检查，而非某种带标签的可玩性基准，因为据我们所知，当前尚无适用于此场景的此类基准；若存在带标签的基准，甚至有一位独立的第二评估者，我们便能够报告评估结果的一致性，而不仅仅是单一团队的判断。评估者即作者本人，且他们并未对生成特定检查点的策略保持盲测状态，因此无法排除预期偏差的可能性——这一担忧尤其直接适用于动作状态一致性的结果，因为该结果正是基于我们自身的根本原因诊断提出的。目前尚未进行系统性、基于共享测试集的全策略空间扫描（涵盖整个 SDK），也未针对每种控制与按压长度执行带有置信区间的统计性动作状态一致性比较；第 5 节报告了单次点击的摘要，而多次点击的按压操作也呈现出相同的模式，但此处因篇幅限制未予列出。此外，《CS:GO》和《CS2》也并非基于同一引擎：除了我们匹配的地图、分辨率、帧率和动作编码外，二者在引擎版本（Source 与 Source 2）以及底层的物理引擎和网络代码上存在差异，因此第 5 节中观察到的部分动作状态一致性差距可能反映了引擎层面的特性，而非纯粹可通过数据选择修正的问题；目前仅凭单一语料库对尚无法将这两者区分开来。更广泛地说，本文中的所有结果均来自同一张地图、同一架构（DIAMOND）以及同一游戏系列；第 1 节中提出的“任务无关”动机正是本研究试图探讨的问题，而非我们在此场景之外已证实的普遍性结论。

paragraphs.en: With the example of two format and scale-matched CounterStrike gameplay corpora, we demonstrated the Virtual2Real gap: benchmarks improve slightly while playability gets significantly worse. Faced with no reliable benchmark to identify the root cause, we used the Kuration SDK to test curation hypotheses directly against qualitative playability rather than against metrics alone (Section 7 ); only the hypothesis grounded in a measured difference between corpora, not an intuition about which behaviors seemed important, moved playability. In our experience, the SDK’s value was in letting us test and discard hypotheses without one-off scripts for each, not in any single curation trick, though we have not measured this efficiency claim against an alternative workflow. We release the Kuration SDK, the curation strategy specifications, and the full evaluation results from this paper so other groups can reproduce, extend, or apply these diagnostics to new corpora.
paragraphs.zh: 以两个格式和规模匹配的《反恐精英》游戏语料库为例，我们揭示了“虚拟到现实”的差距：基准测试表现略有提升，而可玩性却显著下降。 由于没有可靠的基准测试来确定根本原因，我们使用 Kuration SDK 将策展假设直接应用于定性可玩性测试，而非仅依赖指标（第 7 节）；只有基于语料库间实际测量差异的假设——而非对哪些行为重要的直觉判断——才能真正改善可玩性。 根据我们的经验，该 SDK 的价值在于让我们无需为每个假设编写一次性脚本即可进行验证和淘汰，而不是依赖于某项特定的策展技巧，尽管我们尚未将这一效率主张与替代工作流程进行比较。 我们公开了 Kuration SDK、策展策略规范以及本文的全部评估结果，以便其他团队能够复现、扩展或将这些诊断方法应用于新的语料库。

paragraphs.en: In next steps, we will build a physics-conformance metric directly from geometry pass-through and trajectory discontinuity, rather than learned video features. Also, a shared benchmark comparing the SDK’s full strategy space on one held-out set, against all metrics used here plus any physics-conformance metric will make the claims more conclusive. Generalization beyond CS2 : whether the same curation axes (interaction density, spatial coverage, action-state consistency) transfer to real robot teleoperation or egocentric video would make the case for domain-general curation infrastructure concrete rather than analogical.

paragraphs.zh: 以下片段会划分窗口、测量 W 控制项的像素偏移、为每个窗口评分、仅保留至少有一次测量到的按键操作的窗口，并采样一个覆盖均衡的精选集。导入 kuration.gameplay 会注册 .pixel_shift(...)，该函数用于测量每次独立按键或鼠标点击背后的光流位移（第 5 节），以及动作状态一致性评分器，后者会将每个窗口的测量按键操作与所提供的基准线（即每个控制项的预期符号和幅度范围）进行比较，并为每个窗口附加一个异常计数：

paragraphs.en: Every segment in the output carries action_state_anomaly , the count of that window’s own pixel-shift instances that violate the baseline, so a curation strategy can filter, bin, or weight on it directly.
